configuration.guideNhSourcePath.descript: Path to the GuideNH source repository used by schema generation.
configuration.resourcePackPath.descripti: Default GuideNH resource pack workspace path used for local workspace indexing.
configuration.runtimeBridge.host.descrip: GuideNH runtime bridge host. No default is provided for safety.
configuration.runtimeBridge.port.descrip: GuideNH runtime bridge port. No default is provided for safety.
configuration.runtimeBridge.token.descri: GuideNH runtime bridge token. No default is provided for safety.
Allow runtime bridge connections to non-loopback hosts. Keep disabled unless the bridge transport is secured externally.
configuration.runtimeBridge.autoConnectO: Attempt one GuideNH runtime bridge handshake automatically when VS Code starts, using the configured host, port, and token.
